name: Lisa: The Downcast
storyline:
LISA: The Downcast follows 4 drug runners, Jackie, Elijah, Slam Jackson and Matías. They work at the bottom of a long chain of suppliers selling Joy, Glee and other designer drugs to west Olathe from an unknown source to anyone looking to buy.

Little do they know about the consequences that they've made for themselves and west Olathe with doing what's needed to make ends meet.

With this current run almost at an end, Slam Jackson, retired stuntman, decides to do a little bit of off-roading and, well, let's just say it's going to be a long walk back. Unbeknownst to them, their journey back to their base of operations is about to go more off-road than even Slam Jackson has taken them before...
summary:
A fan game based on LISA: The Painful, by Dingaling Productions, out in the far west of Olathe away from the main action going on in the original games.

Currently a demo
